lines: Peace be upon you. I'm your new neighbour.
وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ، أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! ما اسْمُكَ؟
And peace be upon you — welcome! What's your name?
My name is Yusuf. And you, what's your name?
اسْمِي حَمْزَةُ. مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ يا يُوسُفُ؟
My name is Hamza. Where are you from, Yusuf?
I'm Sudanese. Are you a student?
لا، أَنا مُدَرِّسٌ. وَهَذا ابْنِي، هُوَ طالِبٌ.
No, I'm a teacher. And this is my son — he's a student.
ما شاءَ اللهُ. أَنا طَبِيبٌ، وَبَيْتِي هُنا.
Mashallah. I'm a doctor, and my house is here.
Eid Mubarak! Come in — this is my family.
ما شاءَ اللهُ! مَنْ هَذا الرَّجُلُ؟
This is my father, and this is my mother next to him.
هَذا أَخِي الصَّغِيرُ، وَهَذِهِ أُخْتِي الْكَبِيرَةُ.
That's my little brother, and this is my big sister.
How many brothers do you have?
I have three brothers and two sisters.
Your family is big! And where's your grandfather?
My grandfather is in the garden with my uncle.
لا، هُوَ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ. تَفَضَّلْ مَعِي.
No, it's near the mosque. Come with me.
ما شاءَ اللهُ، الْبَيْتُ جَمِيلٌ! كَمْ غُرْفَةً فِيهِ؟
Mashallah, the house is lovely! How many rooms does it have?
It has four rooms, a kitchen and two bathrooms.
هُنا، عَلَى الْيَمِينِ. فِيها كَنَبَةٌ وَتِلْفازٌ.
Here, on the right. There's a sofa and a television in it.
فِي الدَّوْرِ الثَّانِي. فِيها سَرِيرٌ وَمَكْتَبٌ وَنافِذَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ.
Upstairs. There's a bed, a desk and a big window.
لا، أَنا مُسْتَأْجِرٌ. الْإِيجارُ مُرْتَفِعٌ قَلِيلًا!
No, I'm renting. The rent is a bit high!
يا هُدى، مَتى تَسْتَيْقِظِينَ فِي الصَّباحِ؟
Huda, when do you wake up in the morning?
أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ، ثُمَّ أُصَلِّي الْفَجْرَ.
I wake up at six, then I pray Fajr.
And what do you do after the prayer?
I drink tea and read a little.
How do you get to work?
I go by train, and sometimes I walk.
When do you get back home?
أَرْجِعُ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْخامِسَةِ مَساءً، ثُمَّ أَطْبُخُ الْعَشاءَ.
I get back at five in the evening, then I cook dinner.
And when do you go to sleep?
I go to bed early, at ten.
What shall we cook today, Fatima?
Good idea! Do we have vegetables?
Yes, we have tomatoes, onions and carrots.
صَبْرًا، الطَّعامُ جاهِزٌ بَعْدَ نِصْفِ ساعَةٍ.
Patience — the food will be ready in half an hour.
Shall we have dessert after dinner?
Yes, we have dates and cake.
الْيَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةُ. هَلْ تَذْهَبُ إِلى الْمَسْجِدِ؟
Today is Friday. Are you going to the mosque?
Yes, I'm going early for the Friday prayer.
It starts at one in the afternoon.
Is the mosque far from your house?
لا، هُوَ قَرِيبٌ جِدًّا، بِجانِبِ السُّوقِ.
No, it's very close, next to the market.
طَبْعًا! نَتَوَضَّأُ فِي الْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ نَمْشِي مَعًا.
Of course! We'll do wudu at home, then walk together.
نَزُورُ أَبِي، ثُمَّ نَأْكُلُ الْغَداءَ عِنْدَهُ.
We'll visit my father, then have lunch at his place.
هَلْ أَنْتَ طالِبٌ جَدِيدٌ فِي الْمَعْهَدِ؟
Are you a new student at the institute?
وَأَنا أَيْضًا! فِي أَيِّ مُسْتَوًى أَنْتَ؟
Me too! Which level are you in?
How many lessons do you have today?
عِنْدِي ثَلاثَةُ دُرُوسٍ: الْقِراءَةُ، وَالنَّحْوُ، وَالْمُحادَثَةُ.
I have three lessons: reading, grammar and conversation.
Mr Said. He's an excellent teacher.
Where do you revise after lessons?
أُذاكِرُ فِي الْمَكْتَبَةِ، ثُمَّ أَرْجِعُ إِلى السَّكَنِ.
I revise in the library, then go back to my accommodation.
Where do you work now, Walid?
I work as an accountant at a big company.
ما شاءَ اللهُ! هَلْ عَمَلُكَ صَعْبٌ؟
No, it's not hard, but it's long.
How many hours a day do you work?
أَعْمَلُ ثَمانِيَ ساعاتٍ، مِنَ التَّاسِعَةِ إِلى الْخامِسَةِ.
I work eight hours, from nine to five.
And I work as an engineer in a factory.
Yes, I like it a lot, and my colleagues are kind.
Praise God. Good work is a blessing.
Peace be upon you. How much is a kilo of apples?
And peace be upon you. Ten riyals a kilo.
هَذا غالٍ! هَلْ عِنْدَكَ شَيْءٌ أَرْخَصُ؟
That's expensive! Do you have anything cheaper?
الْبُرْتُقالُ بِسِتَّةِ رِيالاتٍ لِلْكِيلُو، وَهُوَ طازَجٌ.
Oranges are six riyals a kilo, and they're fresh.
طَيِّبٌ، أُرِيدُ كِيلُو بُرْتُقالٍ وَنِصْفَ كِيلُو عِنَبٍ.
Fine — I'd like a kilo of oranges and half a kilo of grapes.
Yes, I'd like some bananas too.
Here you are. Thank you very much.
ما رَأْيُكَ؟ نَذْهَبُ إِلى الْحَدِيقَةِ غَدًا؟
What do you think — shall we go to the park tomorrow?
فِكْرَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ، لَكِنْ كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ غَدًا؟
Nice idea, but what's the weather like tomorrow?
الْجَوُّ مُشْمِسٌ وَدافِئٌ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
And today? The sky is cloudy.
نَعَمْ، الْيَوْمَ بارِدٌ، وَفِيهِ رِياحٌ قَوِيَّةٌ.
Yes, today is cold, with strong winds.
We'll stay at home and drink tea!
عَفْوًا، أَنا زائِرٌ هُنا. أَيْنَ وَسَطُ الْمَدِينَةِ؟
Excuse me, I'm visiting. Where's the city centre?
The city centre is close, just after the bridge.
نَعَمْ، فِيها أَسْواقٌ قَدِيمَةٌ وَمَساجِدُ جَمِيلَةٌ.
Yes, it has old markets and beautiful mosques.
The museum is next to the big park.
Should I take the bus or walk?
Walk — the road is pretty and quiet.
Thank you. Where are you from?
أَنا مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَدِينَةِ، وُلِدْتُ هُنا.
I'm from this city — I was born here.
ماذا تَفْعَلُ فِي وَقْتِ الْفَراغِ يا حَسَنُ؟
What do you do in your free time, Hasan?
I play football with my friends.
نَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ فِي الصَّباحِ. وَأَنْتَ؟
We play on Saturday mornings. And you?
I draw nature: mountains, the sea and trees.
هَذِهِ هِوايَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ! هَلْ تَتَعَلَّمُ الْخَطَّ الْعَرَبِيَّ أَيْضًا؟
That's a lovely hobby! Do you learn Arabic calligraphy too?
نَعَمْ، أَتَعَلَّمُهُ مَعَ مُدَرِّسٍ كُلَّ أُسْبُوعٍ.
Yes, I learn it with a teacher every week.
ما شاءَ اللهُ! أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَرى رُسُومَكَ.
Mashallah! I'd like to see your drawings.
